title: Webデザイン
subtitle: Web Design
educationalGoal: In this Web design course, students will learn the concepts behind website construction, including information structure and effective navigation, as part of efforts to impart the knowledge necessary for designing easy-to-read and easy-to-use Web pages. In addition, the characteristics of multimedia material, the use of HTML and CSS, as well as techniques for making Web pages using a laptop computer, will be covered.
advice: Students are expected to acquire the knowledge and skills of webpage production based on the basic concepts of information design, understand the outline of the World Wide Web (WWW), and master fundamental website creation procedures such as planning, design, production, operation and management through practical training. To accomplish this, students will gain an understanding of the basic grammar of HTML and practice the use of CSS as a basic writing method for expressing Web pages. Students will also learn how to support various web browsers and web accessibility, and acquire the skills to offer information on web pages.

requiredKnowledge: Students are expected to be familiar with basic personal computer operations, typing, shortcuts.

activityGoals.body: Be able to browse the World Wide Web and search for information through it.
Be able to write Web pages using text and multimedia in HTML by using a text editor.
Be able to understand the basic steps of web pages to uploading files to a web server.
Be able to create a webpage layout using CSS.
Be able to create Web pages with expressions and information arrangements that suit the purpose.
Be able to understand the concepts of personal information, security, copyright regulations, and netiquette.

lessons.content: Course introduction Lecture: ・What is a Web site? ・Web production flow Practice: ・Set up a web development software
lessons.assignments: Read Chapter 1 of the textbook .  Install an editor to start web production and a browser to browse, and prepare the development environment.

lessons.content: The basics of HTML Lecture: ・Basic structure of a website Practice: ・Writing HTML
lessons.assignments: Read Chapters 4-1, 4-2 of the textbook.  Write your profile in HTML.

lessons.content: The basics of CSS Lecture: ・Decoration with CSS Practice: ・HTML decoration using CSS
lessons.assignments: Read Chapters 4-3-1 to 4-3-9 of the textbook.  Decorate your own profile page with CSS.

lessons.content: Layout with CSS Lecture: ・Layout with CSS Practice: ・Practice of layout with CSS (class and ID)
lessons.assignments: Read Chapters 4-3-10 to 4-3-12 of the textbook.  Decorate your own profile page with CSS.

lessons.content: HTML/CSS exercises and Web fonts Quizzes: ・Lessons from 1-4 weeks Lecture: ・About UI design Practice: ・Basic use of design tools
lessons.assignments: Read chapters 3-1 to 3-4, and 4-4-1 of the textbook.  Practice operating design tools.

lessons.content: Web Design Exercises Lecture: ・Explanation of quiz ・Points to be considered in web design Practice: ・Basic use of design tools
lessons.operation: Self evaluation, Lecture, Practice, and Review
lessons.assignments: Read chapters 3-5 to 3-6 of the textbook.  Practice operating design tools.

lessons.content: Web Design Exercises Lecture: ・About web fonts Practice: ・Designing a portfolio site
lessons.assignments: Read chapter 4-3-5 of the textbook.   Read chapter 2 of the textbook .  List the sites that you would like to use as reference for your portfolio site. Create a description for your portfolio website.

lessons.content: Legal regulations and analytics related to websites Lecture: ・Legal regulations related to websites ・Use of analytics ・Terms of use and privacy policy Practice: ・Designing a portfolio site
lessons.assignments: Read chapter appendix of the textbook.  Create a design for a portfolio website.

lessons.content: Web content composition techniques Lecture: ・How to structure a website according to its purpose Practice: ・Designing a portfolio site
lessons.assignments: Read chapter 2 of the textbook .  Complete the design of the portfolio site.

lessons.content: Prototyping Quizzes: ・Lessons from 5-9 weeks Lecture: ・Prototype of websites using the prototyping tool Practice: ・Prototyping
lessons.assignments: Read chapter 5-1 of the textbook.  Design modifications based on prototyping

lessons.content: Coding Lecture: ・Explanation of quiz ・How to code a website Practice: ・Writing a website with HTML
lessons.operation: Self evaluation, Lecture, Practice, and Review
lessons.assignments: ・Applying HTML and CSS to a Portfolio site

lessons.content: Coding Lecture: ・How to code a website Practice: ・Applying CSS to a Portfolio site
lessons.assignments: ・Applying HTML and CSS to a Portfolio site

lessons.content: Responsive design Lecture: ・About responsive design Practice: ・Applying HTML and CSS to a Portfolio site
lessons.assignments: Read chapter 4-4 of the textbook.  ・Applying HTML and CSS to a Portfolio site

lessons.content: Uploading a Web site Lecture: ・Explanation of exam ・Uploading method of a website Practice: ・Uploading a website (*on campus server) ・Checking the uploaded site in a group
lessons.assignments: Read Chapter 5 of the textbook .  Fixing bugs in the portfolio site and uploading.

lessons.content: Presentation Lecture: ・Comments on the portfolio sites
lessons.assignments: Reflect on your own work while looking other works.
